Name: Nyapu Style Metalcore Goes Cottagecore
Author: nugmods
Description:
New! 2.0 version, now with a content patcher pack and updated art!

Squeaks gave me permission to share this Nyapu edit of Cambria and Co. with Nexus, so here you go! Go check out Metalcore Goes Cottagecore, Squeaks has put a lot of love into Cambria and it shows.

As usual, uses Nyapu's assets with some hand-editing by me. 

New install instructions!

1. Download the zip
2. Unzip the files into your mod folder. That's it! EXCEPT...
3. Make ABSOLUTELY SURE the [NPC] folder is ovewriting your main MGC install. This is for Jupiter's portraits, which can't (currently) be targeted the normal way due to custom companions, and the alternative involves some hacky, questionable stuff I'm not sure I want to do atm.

p.s. the majority of this mod is now a content patcher mod. It is clearly labeled [CP], just like all the other content patcher mods you use. The instructions clearly indicate to only replace Jupiter's portraits. I know you know how content patcher works. It is not a replacer. Do not use it as a replacer. Do not go on Discord and tell other people to use it as a replacer. Don't be rude, read the instructions!

...I [s]still don't know how to use content patcher[/s] NOW KNOW HOW TO USE CONTENT PATCHER

Credits:
Nyapu: for their amazing collection of portraits and the assets used to create these edits
Ottersqueaks: For the Metalcore Goes Cottagecore mod. Seriously, I love Cambria and her silly little crew so much, I would die for her
Mushymato: for the content patcher pack!
